summary.text: Rachel Japuntich is the Republican candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 40 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat John Marty.
She also ran for the seat in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Japuntich lost the November 8, 2022 general election for Minnesota State Senate District 40 to John Marty, 35.1 percent to 64.8 percent.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she was described as an engineer for a medical device company who holds a bachelor's degree in bioproducts engineering from the University of Minnesota and an MBA from its Carlson School of Management.
Her 2026 Republican primary was canceled, and she advanced to the general election without appearing on the primary ballot.
